name: AR 6A/6B

images.credit: Kóspál et al. 2021, Fig. 1 (AR6 panel, crop)

paper.title: Massive Compact Disks around FU Orionis-type Young Eruptive Stars Revealed by ALMA

notes: FUor-like multiple system in NGC 2264; ALMA 1.33 mm continuum resolves components AR 6A (= V912 Mon / Cl* NGC 2264 AR 6), AR 6B, and AR 6C. Distance from Maíz-Apellániz et al. 2019 (719 pc); the Gaia parallax (~1.1 mas) gives a larger distance.
